claims.quote: For too long, people have put up with a railway that often lets them down.
claims.statement: The railway has for too long let people down.

entities.name: Andy Burnham
entities.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, a city that has railways in its DNA. This will bring investment and good jobs
claims.statement: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby and will bring investment and good jobs.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission of better services for passengers.

claims.quote: I’m delighted Becketwell will become GBR’s new home
claims.statement: Becketwell will become the new home of Great British Railways.

claims.quote: we’re investing not just in the railway of tomorrow, but in the people who will build it.
claims.statement: With 600 apprenticeships opening up, the government is investing in the people who will build the railway of tomorrow.

claims.quote: This forms part of our £2.5 billion youth employment support package which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby. Rail has been part of our region for generations and I’m delighted that Great British Railways will be based here, bringing hundreds of jobs into the city.
claims.statement: Great British Railways being based in Derby is fantastic news that will bring hundreds of jobs into the city.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of Great British Railways’ headquarters was unveiled in Derby.

facts.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029
facts.statement: Construction of the new headquarters at Becketwell, Derby, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

facts.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
facts.statement: The Great British Railways headquarters site will accommodate up to 450 staff.

facts.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
facts.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: The decision marks a significant milestone in the government’s plan to establish a publicly owned railway
facts.statement: The government decided on the Great British Railways headquarters, a milestone in its plan to establish a publicly owned railway.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Rail fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: the recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site
facts.statement: A £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north is set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site.

facts.quote: delivered in partnership with the Department for Transport, Derby City Council and the East Midlands Combined Authority
facts.statement: Better public transport links and walking routes around the Derby site are being delivered in partnership with the Department for Transport, Derby City Council and the East Midlands Combined Authority.
